fields.title: Workshop on Scientific Computing
fields.short_description: Annual workshop on scientific computing at FNSPE CTU.
fields.registration_fee_note: Conference fee is free of charge
fields.grant_text: This workshop was supported by the Grant Agency of the Czech Technical University in Prague, grant No. SVK 44/25/F4.
fields.venue_text: Faculty of Nuclear Sciences and Physical Engineering, Pohraniční 1288/1, 405 02 Děčín and MS Teams online
fields.conference_office_text: D. Landovská, Department of Software Engineering, Faculty of Nuclear Sciences and Physical Engineering, Czech Technical University in Prague
fields.program_local_registration_text: Registration for local participants takes place at the conference venue: Thursday: from 13:00 to 14:00 + during coffee breaks between the sessions
fields.program_regular_talks_text: Oral presentation duration is 20 min = 15 min talk + 5 min for discussion.
fields.program_poster_talks_text: Each poster will be briefly introduced in a short 1–3 min presentation.
